message: hermes compile: this program calls tools/models and needs the Go network archive; build it with: go build -buildmode=c-archive -o build/glibhermesnet.a ./cmd/hermesnet
why: tool.call / model.generate lower to hermes_net_* calls in the generated C, and the only carrier of those symbols is the Go network archive (a c-archive containing the AI interface compatibility layer). With no archive resolved, every one of those calls is an unresolved symbol at link time.
fix: run the go build command in the message, or point HERMES_NET_LIB at an existing g* archive (the default lookup is build/glibhermesnet.a)
if the program needs no network or model access, remove tool.call / model.generate and the backend that needs them
